newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian broker raises Bekaert to 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Belgian broker raises Bekaert to 'buy'.

text.p: Bekaert steel wire 23,275 bfr* Bank Delen NV

COMMENT: Taking into account relatively good H1 figures, the growth potential of the emerging markets (accounting for more than 20 percent of turnover) and the end of technical pressure on the price due to areshuffling of the Bel-20 index, it is the right time to buy Bekaert at current levels - it has been underperforming the Bel-20 this year by 16.5 percent.

No significant improvement seen in H2 1996 but towards 1997 operating profits will be supported by lower losses or small profits at Roesler and Trefilest, a limited rebound in steel cord, capacity expansion and a higher average dollar rate.
Estimates: EPS EPS EX (a) P/E Dividend
NOTE - EPS EX is earnings per share excluding exceptionals.
